prompt: You put $200 in a savings account that pays 10% interest a year, and you leave the interest in the account. How much will you have after 3 years?
explanation: Year 1: $200 x 1.10 = $220. Year 2: $220 x 1.10 = $242. Year 3: $242 x 1.10 = $266.20. Simple interest would give only $260, because compound interest also earns interest on past interest.
